requested_outcome: On mobile, saving the vacation party closes only the party picker and leaves the search editor open until the user presses Search.
natural_destination: VII mobile vacation search editor at 390px width
authorization_boundary: Local code and test changes are authorized. Publishing a new public version is not authorized by this request.
no_applicable_lessons_reason: The accepted mobile screenshot lesson applies to public release approval, while this request authorizes a local behavior correction only. Project-specific mobile staged-flow rules provide the governing precedent.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Saving the party still navigates or submits a search on mobile.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate mobile save from desktop immediate search and cover both branches with a regression test.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At 390px, pressing Save party keeps the URL unchanged and closes only the party picker.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The picker closes but the main Search button is not visible or usable.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Return the mobile editor to its overview state after saving and verify the existing sticky Search action is visible.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: After saving, the editor remains open in overview and its Search button is visible and enabled.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix breaks desktop immediate search or loses the selected counts.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep immediate submit behind the desktop viewport guard and verify selected party state persists into the explicit mobile search.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop save still searches immediately; mobile values remain selected until Search is pressed.

affected_family: mobile overlay close and reopen states

sources.label: Mobile preserves staged search flow while desktop may apply immediately

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the click handlers and focused regression contracts are updated
checks: Focused tests prove mobile save closes only the picker
Desktop branch still calls immediate search
Search button becomes reachable in overview

attack_questions: Does Save party change pathname or query on mobile?
Does closing the picker accidentally close the entire mobile search sheet?
Does rotating or widening to desktop leave stale overlay or guest state?
Does the explicit Search action use the latest selected counts?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: A mobile browser run at 390px showing the party picker close, editor remain open, URL remain unchanged, and Search navigate only after the explicit click.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests for vacation and event guest confirmation plus desktop immediate-search preservation.

effectiveness.baseline: Current code calls search directly from the vacation Save party button on every viewport.
effectiveness.target: No mobile navigation before an explicit Search click, with zero regressions in desktop immediate search.
